hooks.command: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; CHANGED=$(git status --porcelain -- . ":!CHANGELOG.md" ":!node_modules" ":!.next" ":!.claude" ":!package-lock.json" ":!pnpm-lock.yaml" ":!yarn.lock" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$CHANGED" ]; then CL=$(git status --porcelain -- CHANGELOG.md 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$CL" ]; then printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Files changed but CHANGELOG.md has no entry yet. Add an entry under ## [Unreleased] summarizing this change (file paths + why, matching the existing format), then finish."}'; fi; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Checking CHANGELOG.md is up to date...
